cards.text: Jesus and His disciples come to the region of Caesarea Philippi. There He asks them a question: "Who do people say the Son of Man is?" I bet every disciple turned to the guy next to him like, "You go first."

cards.question: The disciples tell Jesus what people are saying about Him. Which name do some people say?

cards.text: John the Baptist baptized people in the Jordan River (Matthew 3:6), and others say Elijah, the prophet taken up to heaven in a whirlwind (2 Kings 2:11). Still others say Jeremiah, a prophet God called in the days of Josiah, king of Judah (Jeremiah 1:1-2), or one of the prophets, so it's the whole break room trying to figure out the new manager.
Then Jesus turns it around with "But what about you?" and asks, "Who do you say I am?" Ohhh, no more "people say," now it's YOUR turn.

cards.question: Jesus asks His disciples who they say He is. What does Simon Peter, one of His disciples, answer?

cards.text: Peter goes all the way: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God." Somebody asks ME a question that big, I'm still clearing my throat.

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter, "Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah!" Who does Jesus say revealed this to Peter?
Jesus says Peter learned who He is from flesh and blood.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells him he is Peter, and "on this rock I will build My church" too. The only thing anybody ever built on ME was a pile of old takeout menus in a junk drawer.

cards.question: Jesus says the gates of Hades will prevail against the church He builds on this rock.

cards.text: Jesus also says He will give Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven. I shared a junk drawer with a mystery key that spent YEARS guessing which door it opened, and nobody handed HIM a kingdom!

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter that whatever he binds on earth will be bound in ___.
Now that the disciples know, Jesus tells them to tell everyone that He is the Christ.

cards.text: From that time on, Jesus begins to show His disciples what's ahead. He must go to Jerusalem, suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests and scribes, and be killed.

cards.question: Jesus says He must suffer and be killed in Jerusalem. What does He say happens on the third day?

answers.text: He will be raised to life
He will appear in the temple

cards.text: Peter hears all this. Then Peter, the same Peter Jesus just called blessed, takes Jesus aside.

cards.question: When Peter takes Jesus aside, he begins to rebuke Him.

cards.text: Peter says, "Far be it from You, Lord!" and "This shall never happen to You!" Friend, that's the new guy at work pulling the owner aside to explain how the business runs.
But Jesus turns and says to Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me."

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter he does not have in mind the things of God, but the things of ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells His disciples what it takes to come after Him. Anyone who wants to must deny himself.

cards.question: Jesus says anyone who wants to come after Him must deny himself and follow Him. What must he take up?
Jesus says whoever wants to save his life will ___ it.
Jesus says whoever loses his life for His sake will find it.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks about a man who gains the WHOLE world. Friend, that's not a raise at work, that's owning the company, the building AND the parking lot.

cards.question: Jesus asks what it will profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his ___.

cards.text: Then He asks, "what can a man give in exchange for his soul?" I shared a drawer with an expired coupon that thought it could buy ANYTHING, and even he wouldn't try that trade.
Then Jesus looks ahead. The Son of Man will come in His Father's glory with His angels, and friend, that is NOT a quiet entrance.

cards.question: When the Son of Man comes in His Father's glory with His angels, what does Jesus say He will do?

answers.text: Repay each one for what he has done
Gather only His disciples to Him

cards.text: Jesus has one more thing to tell the people standing there with Him, and He starts with "Truly I tell you" right up front. When He starts like that, friend, you lean in.

cards.question: Jesus says some who are standing there will not taste death before they see something. What is it?

answers.text: The Son of Man coming in His kingdom

findings.problem: This story card has too many beats for one card. It explains who John the Baptist was with a reference, tells what others say about Elijah with a reference, tells what still others say about Jeremiah with a reference, adds 'one of the prophets,' and ends with the break-room joke. All of that sits in two long sentences, and the second is a run-on. Split it, or trim the introductions so the card carries one or two moments.

rule.text: Aim for one beat per story card. Two is the most. If a story card has more than two things happening, split it.

findings.problem: The joke 'The only thing anybody ever built on ME...' compares Papa Dorin to Peter as the thing being built on. That treats Peter himself as 'this rock.' The text puts 'you are Peter' and 'on this rock' side by side but does not say how they connect, and readers disagree about what the rock is. The joke settles a question the text leaves open.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: The joke ends with 'nobody handed HIM a kingdom!' That implies Peter was handed a kingdom. Matthew 16:19 says Jesus will give him 'the keys of the kingdom of heaven,' not the kingdom. The punchline blurs the fact it is built on. It could land on the keys instead, for example: nobody handed that key anything at all.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.

findings.problem: The walkthrough covers only the binding half of Matthew 16:19 ('whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven'). The loosing half ('whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven') never appears on any card, so the baker misses half of what Jesus gives Peter. Add it to card 11 or to a story card after card 12.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
